en.sayed-ali-raza: I praise Allāh seeking completion of His Blessing, submitting to His Glory and expecting safety from committing His sins.
I invoke His help being in need of His Sufficiency (of protection).
He whom He guides does not get astray, He with whom He is hostile gets no protection. He whom He supports does not remain needy.
Praise is most weighty of all that is weighed and the most valuable of all that is treasured.
